description: Search FDA (openFDA Center for Veterinary Medicine) reports of side effects/adverse events in animals given a veterinary drug or parasite preventive — dogs, cats, horses, cattle. Answers "what side effects has Bravecto caused in dogs", "adverse events for fluralaner in cats", "has anyone reported seizures after ivermectin in dogs". Pass a brand/product name via "drug" OR a chemical active ingredient via "active_ingredient" (either works — the tool resolves brand names against the ingredient field, since that is where product names are actually recorded upstream). Reports are spontaneous submissions, not a validated causal or incidence study.

active_ingredient.description: Chemical active ingredient, e.g. "fluralaner", "ivermectin", "moxidectin". Use this OR "drug".

breed.description: Optional: filter to a breed, e.g. "German Shepherd", "Labrador".

reaction.description: Optional: filter to a specific reaction/symptom, e.g. "vomiting", "seizure", "lethargy".

since.description: Optional: only reports received on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

species.description: Animal species: Dog, Cat, Horse, Cattle, Swine, etc. Case-insensitive.

name: vet_adverse_events
title: Vet Adverse Events
